رَيِّقٌ : see رَوْقٌ, in four places, in the former half of the paragraph. ―
-b2- Also The most excellent of anything; (JK, S;) as, for instance, of wine, or beverage, and of rain. (JK.) ―
-b3- And it is said to signify also, (JK, Ibn-'Abbád, O,) or so ↓ رَيْقٌ , (accord. to the copies of the K,) A scanty fall of rain: thus bearing two contr. meanings. (JK, Ibn-'Abbád, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
